editorial:
Imagine moving in with your old aunt to start over, only to meet a woman who completely flips your world upside down. That is exactly what happens to Adele. She is quiet and reserved, but then she meets Beth, who is bold, mysterious, and a bit dangerous. The vibe of the movie feels like a bad dream that you cannot wake up from. It starts off slow, but it quickly turns into a wild ride as Beth pushes Adele to do things she never thought she would. You will feel the tension grow as the line between what is real and what is a trick starts to blur.

The acting is the best part here because the chemistry between the two leads makes everything feel believable. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the twists keep you guessing until the end. If you like movies that mess with your head, you should definitely give this a shot. Since the visuals are so important for the mood, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best experience. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this hidden gem.
endingExplained: You find out that Beth is not who she seems and has been manipulating Adele the entire time. The movie ends with a shocking twist where Adele realizes she has lost her grip on reality. She ends up trapped in a cycle of madness and obsession. The final scenes show that the psychological games Beth played actually worked, leaving Adele broken and alone in a world that no longer makes sense to her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about obsession and mind games.
